question.text: Fund ABC has Total Assets Rs. 80 crore, Total Liabilities Rs. 5 crore, 75,000 units issued. NAV per unit?

explanation.text: The Logic: NAV = (80 crore − 5 crore)/75,000 = 75,00,00,000/75,000 = Rs. 10,000 per unit. The Trap: Dividing by wrong unit count yields different values. Cross-Exam Context: Standard NAV formula. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always show the formula explicitly: (A-L)/Units.
